ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/off-white) pixels comprise approximately 70% of the visible surface, primarily in the central and lower regions, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels (approx. 30%) concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous off-white zones occupy the central and interior regions of both lobes. Dense, low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid band along the trailing edge, transitioning into irregular mottling and heavy stippling in the outer quadrants near the tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a vertical depth estimated at 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, medium-amplitude serrations are present across the entire trailing edge boundary; serration amplitude and irregularity increase significantly towards the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex trajectory from the median notch to the tips, terminating in pointed, slightly upturned distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent clusters of textured, high-contrast yellowish-brown pixel groups (barnacles) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-colored, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity central surfaces of both lobes, showing both parallel and intersecting orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both lateral tips; significant linear scarring across the ventral surface consistent with tooth rake marks.
